# Selfie and UGC video prompts

**Phone-camera shorts that feel filmed: studio vlogs, club selfies, mirror checks, GRWM — prompts per model, labelled AI.**

Prompts phone-camera, UGC-style vertical clips of an AI character that feel filmed, not rendered — talking-to-camera studio vlogs, flash selfies at the club, mirror outfit checks, get-ready-with-me, walk-and-talk out of the club, desk day-in-the-life with the disco ball, storytime on the foil set, visor-reveal vlogs — with front-camera realism cues, first-frame stills, per-model video prompts (Kling 3, Wan 2.6, Hailuo 2.3, Gemini Omni Flash), native ambient audio, hook-first timing, and the ethics line for UGC (always labelled AI, never fake testimonials). Use when making selfie, vlog or creator-style shorts with Claudia or your own character.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 20 min per clip | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Know what makes it read as "filmed on a phone"
2. Fight selfie-framing age drift
3. Make the first frame like a paused phone video
4. Pick the format card
5. Put the hook in the first second
6. Generate with the approval flow
7. QA like a viewer, then like a checker
8. Label it and keep it honest

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
